candidates.change_summary: Remove the line `totalSupply -= _value;` so that burning a token does not reduce totalSupply.
Remove the totalSupply decrement so that burning does not reduce total supply, only changes the burner's balance.
Remove the balanceOf decrement so that burning only reduces total supply but leaves burner balance unchanged.
Change the subtraction to an addition so that burning increases the burner's balance instead of decreasing it.
Change totalSupply decrement to an increment so that totalSupply increases on burn.
Delete the onlyOwner modifier on burn so that any account can burn their own tokens.
Change the onlyOwner modifier's require condition to always pass (true) so that burn can be called by anyone without reverting.
